result_assessed: 3-point MACE (CV death, nonfatal MI, nonfatal stroke), hazard ratio, effect of assignment (ITT)

D1_randomisation.why: 1:1, stratified by eGFR; no held source describes sequence generation or allocation concealment (1.1/1.2 = NI) and no baseline-balance statement is bound.

witnesses.span: Randomization was stratified according to the estimated glomerular filtration rate (eGFR) at screening

D2_deviations_assignment.why: Double-blind, matching placebo; all randomised included in the primary analysis.

witnesses.span: We performed this multicenter, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial at 410 sites in 32 countries.
All the patients who underwent randomization were included in the primary and exploratory analyses

D3_missing_outcome_data.why: Vital status known for 99.7%; 96.8% completed a final visit, died or had a primary outcome.

witnesses.span: The vital status was known in 99.7% of the patients.
A total of 96.8% of the patients completed a final visit, died, or had a primary outcome.

D4_outcome_measurement.why: Adjudicated in a blinded fashion by an external independent committee.

witnesses.span: all of which were adjudicated in a blinded fashion by an external, independent event-adjudication committee.

D5_selection_of_reported_result.why: [revised after blind second read, RoB 2 5.1: an outcome definition is not an analysis plan fixed before unblinding] The 2013 design paper (published before the 2016 results) fixes 3-point MACE as the primary end point; protocol and SAP published with the article (not held here).

witnesses.span: The primary end point is the time from randomization to a composite outcome consisting of the first occurrence of cardiovascular death, nonfatal myocardial infarction, or nonfatal stroke.
The statistical analysis plan is available with the protocol at NEJM.org.

D2_treatment_discontinuation.note: stopped treatment -- recorded for D2 context; NOT missing outcome data
D2_treatment_discontinuation.why: time on regimen 84% vs 83%; more stopped liraglutide for adverse events

witnesses.span: The mean percentage of time that patients received the trial regimen was 84% for liraglutide and 83% for placebo.

overall.rule: RoB 2 algorithm on the proposals; not computed when any domain lacks evidence
